args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link currently uses a default of "http://localhost:3000" when a proper public URL is not set, causing the link to be incorrect for users not running locally. This change proposes to verify and set the BASE_URL environment variable correctly so that the reset-password link in the email points to the proper public URL instead of localhost.
